title: Degraded checkout
description: Customer support escalation: error budget burn on orders-api; 38.3% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: A slow query on table carts (missing index plus lock contention) held connections for seconds, saturating the orders-api connection pool (max 15).
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in orders-api logs
orders-api p95 latency rises from ~107ms to ~5.3s
orders-api memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
database query latency and CPU elevated; slow statement and lock wait logs
resolution: Terminated the long-running queries, added the missing index and set a statement_timeout for the offending query.
